questions.question: Which country features the highest number of time zones within its national territory and dependencies?
questions.fun_fact: France spans 12 different time zones globally due to its numerous overseas regions and territories.

questions.question: What is the only metal that is liquid at standard room temperature and pressure?
questions.fun_fact: Mercury has a very low melting point of roughly -38.83 degrees Celsius, making it liquid under normal conditions.

questions.question: The famous Edict of Milan, which proclaimed religious tolerance in the Roman Empire, was enacted in which year?
questions.fun_fact: Emperors Constantine the Great and Licinius issued the Edict of Milan to officially legalize Christianity throughout the Roman Empire.

questions.question: Which 1993 Steven Spielberg film holds the record for winning the most Academy Awards without capturing the Best Picture prize?
questions.fun_fact: Jurassic Park won three Oscars for technical achievements in sound and visual effects during the 1994 ceremony.

questions.question: Saffron, the world's most expensive spice by weight, is harvested from which specific part of a crocus flower?
questions.fun_fact: It takes approximately 75,000 saffron flowers, harvested entirely by hand, to produce just a single pound of saffron threads.

questions.question: What unique physical adaptation helps camels prevent sand from entering their eyes during desert storms?
options: The ability to completely seal their eyelids shut
questions.fun_fact: Camels have exceptionally long, thick double rows of eyelashes that act as a natural physical barrier against blowing desert sand.

questions.question: In the sport of curling, what is the official term for the heavy granite stone used by players?
questions.fun_fact: Curling stones are traditionally carved from a specific type of rare granite found only on Ailsa Craig, an island off the coast of Scotland.

questions.question: What is the linguistic term for words that are spelled exactly the same way but have different meanings and origins, such as 'bat' (the animal) and 'bat' (sports equipment)?
questions.fun_fact: Homographs share identical spelling, though they may or may not be pronounced the same way.

questions.question: Which spacecraft holds the record for being the farthest human-made object from Earth?
questions.fun_fact: Launched in 1977, Voyager 1 crossed the heliopause into interstellar space in 2012 and continues to transmit data.

questions.question: Lake Baikal in Siberia contains what remarkable fraction of the world's unfrozen surface fresh water?
questions.fun_fact: Despite holding roughly one-fifth of the globe's fresh liquid surface water, Lake Baikal is also the deepest lake on Earth.
